title: Agent skill pack or individual skill
description: Agent skills, at two granularities held in one file. kind: pack is a bundle — a vendor-published pack, a curated catalogue, or a public registry — and carries skill_count. kind: skill is one individually verified skill and carries domain plus the id of the pack it came from. Packs are never bulk-expanded into their contents: an individual skill appears here only when a human pointed at it and it verified against a machine-readable source.

id.description: Immutable slug, unique across every category in the repo.

provider.description: Who publishes and maintains it — an org, or the registry handle that owns the package.

category.description: Where it comes from: catalog = first-party curated set (openai/skills, anthropics/skills). vendor-pack = published by a product vendor for its own API. registry = a public marketplace of third-party skills. community = an individual maintainer's pack.

kind.description: pack = a collection, catalogue or registry entry. skill = one individual skill, verified on its own.

domain.description: What the skill is about. Required when kind is skill; absent on packs.

parent.description: For kind: skill, the id of the pack it belongs to in this same file. Omitted for standalone skills published outside a pack.

skill_count.description: Number of skills in a pack, read from an API or a repository tree. Only meaningful on kind: pack; individual skills do not carry a count.

install.description: Copy-pasteable install command. Verified by running it where a CLI is involved.

verified.description: ISO date the URL and stated counts were last checked.

notes.description: Caveats worth reading. A string or a list of strings.
